title: The Knock on the Studio Door
youtube_title: The Knock on the Studio Door | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Speaking up once, softly, can open a door.
summary: At a music corner with a drum and a recorder, Eko feels shy about a knock on a studio door that was already ajar. Instead of pretending not to care, Eko tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Auntie Luz stays kind and does not push for a show.
